construct.name: decision configuration sensitivity and option-order invariance
construct.intended_use: Verify that complete configuration identity is explicit and that semantic order invariance can be distinguished from deliberate position-biased changes over matched synthetic cases and declared slices.
construct.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic configuration-sensitivity software reference only; no human fairness effect, normative fairness judgement or empirical generalization claim.

units.dependence_statement: The same 12 case identifiers are paired across configurations; configuration contrasts are designed comparisons, not independent samples.

sources.missingness_semantics: Fixture cells are declared and complete; absent, unsupported and not-applicable values are not encoded as zero.

evaluation_distribution.sampling_frame: Two configurations evaluated over 12 matched cases with declared cohort slices and semantic option-order controls.

factors.weight_interpretation: Equal design coverage for fixed reference and changed decision-relevant configuration.
Designed semantic invariance and position-bias stress conditions; not real-world frequency.

perturbation_families.rationale: Reorder display positions while preserving semantic option IDs, preferences and task contract.
perturbation_families.validity_check: Remap allocations to stable option IDs and compare per-case selections.
expected_invariants: Pure semantic permutation yields zero paired flips.
Case IDs and cohort labels remain identical across arms.
perturbation_families.seed_policy: Exact deterministic paired cases; no random seed.

perturbation_families.rationale: Change one declared configuration facet at a time, with complete configuration identity and digest updated.
perturbation_families.validity_check: A changed facet must change the canonical configuration digest and trigger re-audit.
expected_invariants: No decision-relevant change may reuse the previous configuration identity.
Multi-facet contrasts are never described as single-factor causal effects.

replication_design.dependence_assessment: The same 12 case identifiers are paired across configurations; configuration contrasts are designed comparisons, not independent samples.
replication_design.sample_size_rationale: One deterministic run is sufficient to check exact software contracts and negative controls; it does not support confidence intervals or population inference.

metrics.aggregation: paired flips divided by identical matched case count; by configuration pair and cohort

metrics.construct_dimension: selection rate by declared cohort slice
metrics.aggregation: selected numerator divided by declared denominator; preserve counts

metrics.construct_dimension: sensitivity of decisions across declared configuration set
metrics.aggregation: maximum minus minimum selection rate across declared configurations; retain each facet contrast
changed decision-relevant facets produce distinct canonical digest

baselines.description: Frozen reference model/configuration and case set.
Expected zero-flip control under semantic option reordering.

negative_controls.intervention: Permute visible option order and remap output by stable semantic option ID.
Use the synthetic position-biased configuration over the same 12 cases.
negative_controls.expected_result: The fixture produces four paired flips; no human effect is inferred.

negative_controls.intervention: Change a decision-relevant configuration facet without updating the canonical configuration digest.
negative_controls.expected_result: Manifest semantic validation rejects the stale digest.

holdouts.leakage_control: No empirical observations are used; external generalization is not claimed.

reproduction.runtime_environment: Rust edition 2024; deterministic synthetic reference; exact-head GitHub Actions workflow
reproduction.humanity_atlas_run_artifact_ref: Not applicable: synthetic reference execution only; no complete Humanity Atlas run artifact is claimed.

claim_report.claim_ceiling: Tier 1 deterministic configuration-sensitivity software reference only; no human fairness effect, normative fairness judgement or empirical generalization claim.
known_limitations: The 12 cases and cohort labels are synthetic and do not represent a real applicant or population distribution.
A decision-flip rate is a descriptive stability metric, not a causal effect or a fairness criterion.
The preference/selection rule is not a universal normative allocation rule.
The configuration digest is a reproducibility identity; it does not authenticate model behavior or prove a prompt component was faithfully executed.
unsupported_strata: Real human populations, institutions, regions, infrastructure systems and operational policy settings.

components.notes: Synthetic oracle or explicit deterministic controller; not a human or LLM.
Stable serial execution in declared input order.
Reject invalid or out-of-contract inputs; no silent repair.
Capture every declared input, step, output and metric; missing records fail closed.
No unseeded random source is used by this deterministic fixture.

scheduler_policy.update_order: stable declared fixture order; deterministic serial execution
scheduler_policy.tie_breaking_rule: stable identifier then stable input index

exposure_policy.eligibility_rule: not applicable to this deterministic reference fixture
exposure_policy.state_visibility: all declared synthetic inputs are visible to the benchmark runner
